purpose: Choose a bounded-lookahead tradeoff from existing offload profiles, not a speedup claim.
observations: A0001 keeps four one-layer pinned/GPU slots: pipeline capacity 32/256/512 MiB per placement at b1/b8/b16 prefill.
Slot release occurs after k+m is enqueued, before later attention/MLP work, leaving a possible overlap window for the following group.

One-layer gather/H2D diagnostics are about 0.339 ms at b1 and 3.941 ms at b8; whole-model prefill is about 29.4/209.5 ms over 24 layers. Component and average-layer times are not independent stage bounds.
Doubling host buffering in A0010 did not improve model latency; its mechanism was not isolated.
hypothesis: One slot may retain enough inter-layer overlap while reducing pinned/device working set and cache pressure. Loss of lookahead may instead starve compute.
declared_change: Limit automatic pipeline to one slot, preserving explicit manual pipeline depths, group size, gather/copy/event ordering and all fresh lookups.
not_claimed: No latency prediction or attribution of earlier slowdowns solely to cache pressure.
